aboutPage.title: The ticketing platform that simplifies your outings
aboutPage.intro: Babicho connects event organizers and the public through a simple, secure platform built for West Africa: concerts, festivals, conferences, sports or shows, everything can be booked in a few clicks.
aboutPage.missionText: Make event ticketing accessible to everyone: organizers save time and gain visibility, while buyers purchase tickets with confidence, wherever they are, using local payment methods.

aboutPage.value2Text: Creating an event or buying a ticket should take minutes, not hours.

faqPage.title: Frequently asked questions
faqPage.intro: Find answers to the most common questions about Babicho. Can't find yours? Contact us directly.
faqPage.q1: How do I buy a ticket on Babicho?
faqPage.a1: Search for an event, choose your ticket type and quantity, then pay online with Orange Money, MTN MoMo, Moov Money, Wave or a bank card. Your digital ticket with QR Code is immediately available in your "My tickets" space.
faqPage.q2: How do I get my tickets after purchase?
faqPage.a2: Your tickets are automatically saved in your personal space, under "My tickets", and also emailed to you. Show the QR Code at the entrance, on your phone or printed.
faqPage.q3: Can I get a refund for a ticket?
faqPage.a3: Refund conditions depend on the policy set by each organizer for their event. If an event is cancelled or postponed by the organizer, you are automatically notified of the next steps.
faqPage.q4: How do I create an event as an organizer?
faqPage.a4: Create an organizer account, complete your profile, then use the 4-step event creation wizard to fill in the details, ticket types and publish your event page.
faqPage.a5: Babicho supports the main mobile money methods in West Africa (Orange Money, MTN MoMo, Moov Money, Wave) as well as Visa and Mastercard bank cards.
faqPage.q6: How much does it cost to use Babicho as an organizer?
faqPage.a6: Babicho takes a commission on each ticket sold, with no fixed fee to create an event. Full details of our plans are available on the Organizer pricing page.
faqPage.q7: How do I change or reset my password?
faqPage.a7: From the login page, click "Forgot password" and follow the instructions sent by email to set a new password.
faqPage.q8: How do I check tickets at the entrance of my event?
faqPage.a8: A QR Code access control scanner, available from your organizer space, lets you validate each ticket in real time on the day of the event.
faqPage.stillQuestion: Can't find the answer to your question?
faqPage.noResultsHint: Try other keywords or contact our team directly.
faqPage.q9: Can I give or transfer a ticket to someone?
faqPage.a9: Yes, if the organizer allows transfers for their event. From "My tickets", pick the ticket then "Transfer": the person receives a link to accept it, and the ticket is then attached to their account.
faqPage.q10: The event is sold out, what can I do?
faqPage.a10: Join the waiting list from the event page: you are notified as soon as a spot opens up.
faqPage.q11: How do I use a promo code?
faqPage.a11: Enter your code in the order summary before paying: the discount applies automatically if the code is valid for the event.
faqPage.q12: Can I create promo codes for my event?
faqPage.a12: Yes. From your organizer space, "Promo codes" section, you set the discount, the validity period and the number of uses.

termsPage.title: Terms of use
termsPage.intro: These terms govern the use of the Babicho platform by buyers and event organizers. By creating an account or using the site, you agree to these terms.
termsPage.s1Text: Babicho is an event ticketing platform that connects event organizers with ticket buyers, and provides online sales, payment and access control tools.
termsPage.s2Text: Some features require creating an account. You are responsible for keeping your credentials confidential and for any activity carried out from your account.
termsPage.s3Text: Every ticket bought on Babicho comes with a unique, personal QR Code. It must be shown, digitally or printed, to access the relevant event. Babicho is not responsible for the content, running or cancellation of an event, which is the organizer's responsibility.
termsPage.s4Text: Displayed prices are set by the organizer and include, where applicable, Babicho's service fees. Payment is made online through the methods offered on the platform (mobile money, bank card).
termsPage.s5Text: If an event is cancelled or postponed by the organizer, buyers are notified and refunded according to the refund policy applicable to that event, shown on the event page.
termsPage.s6Text: The organizer guarantees the accuracy of the information published about their event and agrees to comply with the regulations applicable to running it, including any required permits.
termsPage.s7Text: Babicho's brands, logos and platform content are protected. Any unauthorized reproduction is prohibited. Organizers retain ownership of the content they publish (visuals, event descriptions).
termsPage.s8Text: Babicho acts as a technical intermediary between organizers and buyers. Babicho cannot be held liable for disputes relating to the running of an event, which is the organizer's responsibility.
termsPage.s9Text: These terms are governed by the law of Côte d'Ivoire. Any dispute will, failing an amicable resolution, be submitted to the competent courts of Abidjan.
termsPage.s10Text: For any question about these terms, you can reach us via the Contact page.

privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPage.intro: This policy explains what personal data Babicho collects, why, and how you can exercise your rights.
privacyPage.s1Text: We collect the information you provide (name, email, phone), data related to your orders and tickets, as well as technical browsing data (IP address, device type).
privacyPage.s2Text: Your data is used to create and manage your account, process your orders and payments, generate your tickets, send you useful notifications and improve the platform.
privacyPage.s3Text: Your data is only shared with providers necessary for the service to work (payment, email delivery) and with the organizer of the event you are buying a ticket for, as needed for access control.
privacyPage.s4Text: Your data is kept for as long as necessary to manage your account and orders, then archived or deleted in accordance with applicable legal obligations.
privacyPage.s5Text: In accordance with Ivorian law no. 2013-450 of 19 June 2013 on the protection of personal data, you have the right to access, correct and delete your data. You can exercise these rights at any time from your "Settings" area or by contacting us, and you may refer a dispute to the ARTCI (Côte d'Ivoire telecommunications/ICT regulatory authority).
privacyPage.s6Text: Babicho uses cookies that are necessary for the site to work (login, language preferences) and, with your consent, anonymous audience measurement. You can change your choice at any time via "Manage cookies".
privacyPage.s7Text: Payments and ticket verifications are processed server-side, never in the browser, to guarantee the security of your data and transactions.
privacyPage.s8Text: For any question about your personal data, contact us via the Contact page.

organizerPricingPage.title: The more you sell, the less you pay
organizerPricingPage.intro: No subscription or setup fee: Babicho only earns on paid tickets sold. As your cumulative sales grow, your commission drops automatically.
organizerPricingPage.yourRate: Your current commission: {rate}% ({sales} FCFA in cumulative sales).
organizerPricingPage.yourNext: Only {amount} FCFA more in sales to reach {rate}%.
organizerPricingPage.commissionNote: Commission applies only to paid tickets actually sold. Free events are never charged. The rate applied to a sale is that of your tier at the time of the sale.
organizerPricingPage.payerIntro: For each event, you choose who bears Babicho's commission. You can change it at any time: the change applies to future sales.
organizerPricingPage.payerOrganizerText: The displayed price is what the buyer pays. The commission is deducted from what you receive. Example: 5,000 FCFA ticket, 6% commission → the buyer pays 5,000 FCFA, you receive 4,700 FCFA.
organizerPricingPage.payerBuyerText: A service fee is added to the ticket price at checkout. You receive the full price. Example: 5,000 FCFA ticket, 6% commission → the buyer pays 5,300 FCFA, you receive 5,000 FCFA.
organizerPricingPage.simIntro: Enter your ticket price and number of sales: see the commission and what you keep, tier by tier, from your first sale.

organizerPricingPage.simNote: Indicative estimate on paid tickets, excluding any payment fees.
organizerPricingPage.customText: Large volumes, festivals, dedicated subdomain: contact our team to negotiate a suitable rate.
organizerPricingPage.faqTitle: Frequently asked questions about our pricing
organizerPricingPage.faq1q: Are there any fees to create an event?
organizerPricingPage.faq1a: No, creating and publishing an event is free. The commission is only charged on tickets sold.
organizerPricingPage.faq2a: You choose for each event: deduct it from your revenue, or add it as a service fee paid by the buyer.
organizerPricingPage.faq3q: When do I get paid for my sales?
organizerPricingPage.faq3a: Your sales and net amount are visible in real time in your organizer space. Our team will explain the payout terms to you.
organizerPricingPage.faq4q: How does my commission go down?
organizerPricingPage.faq4a: Automatically: as soon as your cumulative sales reach the next tier, the commission drops for all your following sales. You don't need to ask for anything or pay anything.

howPage.title: How it works
howPage.intro: From finding an event to walking in, or from creating your page to getting paid: Babicho makes every step simple.

howPage.b2Text: Pick the ticket type and quantity, then apply a promo code if you have one.

securityPage.title: Security and payments
securityPage.intro: Buying a ticket should be worry-free. Here is how Babicho protects your payments, tickets and data.
securityPage.c1Text: Payments are handled by our payment partner. Babicho never stores your secret code or your card details.
securityPage.c2Text: Each ticket carries a unique QR code. At the door it is checked server-side and can only be validated once.
securityPage.c3Text: The site runs over HTTPS and public forms are protected against bots and abuse.
securityPage.c4Text: Access to your information is restricted to your account. You stay in control (access, correction, deletion).
securityPage.c5Text: Administrative actions are logged and administrator accounts are protected by two-factor authentication.
securityPage.c6Text: Doubt about a payment or a ticket? Our team based in Côte d'Ivoire will answer.
securityPage.payText: Mobile money and Visa or Mastercard cards, depending on the options offered at checkout.
securityPage.reportText: Fake ticket, suspicious payment, potential vulnerability: write to us, we handle every report.

refundPage.title: Refund policy
refundPage.intro: This page explains when a ticket can be refunded and how to proceed. It supplements the terms of sale.
refundPage.s1Text: Tickets sold on Babicho are generally neither taken back nor exchanged. Each organiser sets the refund policy for their event, shown on the event page before purchase.
refundPage.s2Text: If the organiser cancels the event, buyers are informed and refunded according to the applicable policy. You do not need to do anything until you receive instructions.
refundPage.s3Text: If an event is postponed, your ticket generally remains valid for the new date. If it does not suit you, refund conditions are specified by the organiser.
refundPage.s4Text: Write to us from the Contact page with your order number and the event concerned. We pass your request to the organiser and reply as soon as possible.
refundPage.s5Text: An approved refund is made through the payment method used at purchase, where that method allows it. Timing depends on the payment operator or bank.
refundPage.s6Text: Babicho service fees, where they apply, follow the fate of the order. Any breakdown is shown before payment.
refundPage.s7Text: A lost ticket is not refunded, but it remains available in your “My tickets” area. You can transfer a ticket to someone else from your account. Any fraudulent ticket is invalidated.

cookiesPage.title: Cookie policy
cookiesPage.intro: This page explains what data is stored in your browser when you use Babicho, and how to manage your choices.
cookiesPage.s1Text: A cookie is a small file saved in your browser. We also use equivalent technologies (local storage) to remember certain preferences.
cookiesPage.s2Text: They let you sign in, secure your session and remember your language. Without them the site cannot work: they do not require consent.
cookiesPage.s3Text: We store choices locally such as light or dark theme, the selected country or whether you finished the guided tour, so we don't ask again.
cookiesPage.s4Text: Only with your consent, we use anonymous audience measurement to understand which pages are useful and improve the platform. It is not loaded if you decline.
cookiesPage.s5Text: You can change your choice at any time with the button below or via “Manage cookies” at the bottom of the page. You can also delete cookies in your browser settings.
cookiesPage.s6Text: A question about cookies or your data? Write to us from the Contact page.
